suppress.notes: kotlin-stdlib-jdk7/jdk8 1.8.x are empty placeholder jars (manifest and module-info.class only). Their code moved into kotlin-stdlib in Kotlin 1.8, and kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 constrains them to 1.8.x on purpose (some libraries pull 1.8.21). CVE-2020-29582 (createTempDir, fixed in 1.4.21) and CVE-2026-53914 (build cache metadata, fixed in 2.4.20) match only on the version label; the project compiles with Kotlin 2.4.20.

androidx.browser is the Custom Tabs support library. The scanner maps it to the CPE of the old AOSP stock "Android Browser" app; CVE-2008-7298 concerns that browser's cookie handling, not this library.

org.jetbrains.compose.runtime is the Compose Multiplatform runtime (pulled in by Coil 3), which on Android forwards to androidx.compose.runtime. The scanner maps it to the CPE of the JetBrains Runtime, the JDK build used by IntelliJ; CVE-2025-29903 is a macOS dependency-injection issue in that JDK, not in this library.
